in_hebrew.name: אינגוואר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Old Norse 'Ing', meaning 'God', and 'varr', meaning 'protector'. In Hebrew, the name could be transliterated as 'El-hanan' (God is gracious) or 'El-shaddai' (God Almighty), depending on the desired meaning.

in_greek.name: Ειγγκαρ
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Old Norse 'Ing', meaning 'God', and 'varr', meaning 'strong'. In Greek, the name could be transliterated as 'Theon-kratos' (God-powerful) or 'Theos-amnos' (God-man), depending on the desired meaning.

in_latin.name: Ingvarius
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Old Norse 'Ing', meaning 'God', and 'varr', meaning 'protector'. In Latin, the name could be transliterated as 'Deus-protector' (God-protector) or 'Divus-amicus' (Divine-friend), depending on the desired meaning.
